tickerText: [TENNIS] Nitto ATP Finals turn to Tuesday's McEnroe Group as Alexander Zverev meets Ben Shelton and Arthur Fils faces Rafael Jodar, after Carlos Alcaraz and Daniil Medvedev each opened 1-0 in the Ivan Lendl Group on Monday in Turin • [SQUASH] PSA Gold China Open first-round play begins in Shanghai at the Diamond Squash Center, with top-seeded Sivasangari Subramaniam headlining a 48-player field that includes Mostafa Asal and Nouran Gohar • [BADMINTON] LI-NING Hong Kong Open starts at Kai Tak as the final HSBC Race to Finals stop, with Anders Antonsen promoted to No. 1 in the draw and high stakes around Kidambi Srikanth versus Koki Watanabe for Lakshya Sen's qualification • [PICKLEBALL] Proton Daytona Beach Open moves to the round of 64 at Pictona from 10 a.m. ET, with main-draw streaming noon–8 p.m. on PickleballTV and YouTube in a 1,000-point Carvana PPA week • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Star Contender Muscat rolls through day-two qualifying in Oman with 200-plus players from 37 nations chasing $300,000 before Wednesday's main draw led by Dang Qiu, Darko Jorgic and Satsuki Odo

newsItems.title: McEnroe Group Awaits
newsItems.excerpt: Nitto ATP Finals day three spotlights the McEnroe Group as Alexander Zverev and Ben Shelton square off at 1-1 and Arthur Fils meets Rafael Jodar, after Carlos Alcaraz beat Frances Tiafoe and Daniil Medvedev topped Flavio Cobolli on Monday in Turin.

newsItems.title: Shanghai Gold Begins
newsItems.excerpt: The PSA China Open opened round one Tuesday in Shanghai, kicking off a $279,000 Gold event with Sivasangari Subramaniam as women's top seed and Mostafa Asal among 48 players from 14 countries at the Diamond Squash Center.

newsItems.title: Muscat Qualifiers Continue
newsItems.excerpt: WTT Star Contender Muscat's second qualifying day runs at the Sultan Qaboos Sports Complex before Wednesday's main draw, with top contenders including Dang Qiu, Darko Jorgic and Satsuki Odo among 200-plus entrants from 37 countries.

newsItems.title: Daytona Main Draw
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour's Proton Daytona Beach Open advances to the round of 64 Tuesday at Pictona in Holly Hill, with gates at 10 a.m. ET and marquee courts streaming noon–8 p.m. on PickleballTV and YouTube.
